blind.description: A stylized wooden apothecary cabinet with six columns of small labeled drawers with tiny knobs. Above the drawers is an open recessed shelf holding six ceramic or glass jars. The flat top surface holds a round dark green glass jug/bottle and a pile of dried yellow and magenta herbs or flowers. The cabinet has molded trim on the sides and sits on four small wooden feet. All surfaces are solid, stylized, and hand-painted.
blind.from_above: A reddish-brown rectangular wooden tabletop with a round dark green bottle with a central neck opening on the left, and an elongated cluster of yellow and pinkish-purple dried herbs or flowers on the right.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 60% of the figure's height (about 3.5 feet tall to the tabletop, nearly 4 feet to top of bottle) and approximately 2.5 to 3 feet wide.

notes: footprint proportion 1.58x off the catalog (4.4 x 1.4 ft)
